test.name: Spec 0011 step 11: secret entry and reveal flows in the Debug Design Gallery

expected: With a real stacklyd on a temporary STACKLY_ROOT (file keychain) and a fixture credential, the Secrets page of the Debug Design Gallery fills a reference through the entry sheet (limits hold Save, Replace is offered when a value exists), shows the value only after Show and hides it again after 30 seconds, on Hide, when the window closes, and when the app loses focus, and Copy puts the full text on the pasteboard so it clears after 90 seconds unless something else was copied since; VoiceOver reads the hidden value as Password hidden, every control is reachable and usable from the keyboard, and the fixture credential prefix appears in no daemon log, registry file, or app log
steps: Terminal A, repo root: build both: `cargo build -q -p stacklyd && cargo xtask build-app`. Expect `BUILD SUCCEEDED`.

Terminal A: make a short temporary root and name the daemon log: `export ROOT=$(mktemp -d /tmp/stk.XXXXXX); echo $ROOT`. Keep this shell for every later command (the root keeps the daemon on a file keychain, never the login Keychain).
Terminal A: start the daemon and keep it running: `STACKLY_ROOT=$ROOT cargo run -q -p stacklyd 2>&1 | tee $ROOT.daemon.log`.

Terminal B (same ROOT: `export ROOT=<the path from step 2>`): make a fixture credential and put it on the pasteboard: `printf 'stackly-fixture-credential-%s' $(uuidgen | tr -d - | tr A-Z a-z) | pbcopy`. Do not type it by hand and do not use a real password.

Terminal B: start the Debug app on the same root: `STACKLY_ROOT=$ROOT target/xcode/Build/Products/Debug/Stackly.app/Contents/MacOS/Stackly`. Expect the main window to connect to the daemon (no unreachable banner).

In the app menu bar choose Window > Design Gallery, then pick Secrets in the sidebar. Expect the reference `local:debug/gallery/password`, the buttons Open Entry Sheet, Check Status, Delete Reference…, and a Connection string row showing `postgres://admin:****@127.0.0.1:5432/app` with Show and Copy.
Click Check Status. Note the text (a reference that was never filled should report a not found style failure, not a value). Note it.

Click Open Entry Sheet. Expect one row for the reference with `No value is stored.`, a Generate / Enter segmented control, and Done disabled. Click Enter. Type `short`: expect `Use at least 8 characters.` and Save disabled. Click the Show button next to the field: the typed text becomes visible; click Hide: it is dots again.

Select the field text, delete it, then paste (Cmd-V) the fixture credential. Expect the hint to go back to `8 to 64 characters` and Save enabled. Press Tab repeatedly and note the focus order (picker, field, Show, Save, Cancel, Done). Click Save. Expect `Saved` and Done enabled. Click Done: the page says `The entry sheet finished: every row is saved.`.
Click Check Status: expect `Status: present`, revision 1, and the store line `available (file)`.

Click Open Entry Sheet again, choose Enter, type `another-fixture-value-1`, click Save. Expect `A value is stored already.` with a Replace button. Click Replace: expect `Saved`. Click Cancel. Expect `The entry sheet was cancelled.`.

In the Connection string row click Show. Expect the masked text replaced by `postgres://admin:<the fixture value you last saved>@127.0.0.1:5432/app`, and the button now says Hide. Start a stopwatch: after about 30 seconds the text must go back to the masked form on its own. Note the measured seconds.

Click Show, then click Hide: expect the masked text at once. Click Show, then click another app (the app loses focus), then come back: expect the masked text. Click Show, then close the Design Gallery window (Cmd-W) and reopen it from Window > Design Gallery: expect the masked text.

Click Copy. Expect `Copied. The clipboard clears in 90 seconds.`. Terminal B: `pbpaste` should print the full URI including the fixture value. Wait 90 seconds from the click, run `pbpaste` again: expect empty output. Note the seconds.

Click Copy again. At once run `echo something-else | pbcopy` in Terminal B. After 90 seconds from the click, `pbpaste` must still print `something-else` (the clear is skipped because the pasteboard changed).
Click Copy once more and quit the app (Cmd-Q) within 90 seconds. `pbpaste` must print nothing. Start the app again with the step 5 command for the following steps and open the Secrets page.

VoiceOver: press Cmd-F5 to start it. In the Secrets page move to the Connection string row (VO-Right). Expect `Password, hidden` with the reference read as its value, then buttons `Show Password` and `Copy Password`. Activate Show Password (VO-Space): expect the button to be read as `Hide Password`. Wait 30 seconds: expect the announcement `Password hidden`. Open the entry sheet and move through it: expect the reference, the reason, the source control, the field named by the reference, and the Show button read as `Show <reference>`. Press Cmd-F5 to stop VoiceOver.

Keyboard only: turn on System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard navigation. Without the mouse: Tab to Open Entry Sheet and press Space; Tab through the sheet; press Space on Show next to the field; press Escape to cancel the sheet. Tab to Show on the Connection string row and press Space, then Space again (Hide), then Tab to Copy and press Space. Note any control you could not reach or activate.

Dynamic Type and contrast: in System Settings > Accessibility > Display turn on Increase contrast, look at the Secrets page and the sheet (hint, error, and Saved text must stay readable), then turn it off. Resize the Design Gallery window to its narrowest width and note any clipped text.

Leak scan, Terminal B: `grep -rl --exclude-dir=keychain 'stackly-fixture-credential-' $ROOT $ROOT.daemon.log; echo exit=$?`. Expect no file listed and `exit=1`. Then `log show --last 20m --predicate 'process == "Stackly"' | grep -c 'stackly-fixture-credential-'`. Expect 0.
Cleanup: click Delete Reference… and confirm Delete (expect `Deleted.`). Quit the app (Cmd-Q). Terminal A: Ctrl-C the daemon. Terminal B: `rm -rf $ROOT $ROOT.daemon.log`.

First reveal on the login Keychain while the SecurityAgent dialog shows (review of spec 0011, Major 2). This step touches the real login Keychain and the real Application Support folder, so do it only when you accept a temporary `stackly-secret` item there. Terminal A: stop the daemon from step 3 (Ctrl-C), then touch a daemon source file and rebuild so the ad hoc signature changes and the login Keychain asks again: `touch apps/daemon/src/main.rs && cargo build -q -p stacklyd`; start the daemon without STACKLY_ROOT: `cargo run -q -p stacklyd`. Terminal B: start the Debug app without STACKLY_ROOT (`target/xcode/Build/Products/Debug/Stackly.app/Contents/MacOS/Stackly`), open Window > Design Gallery > Secrets, open the entry sheet, Generate a value for `local:debug/gallery/password` and Save (allow the dialog if it appears). Quit the daemon and repeat the touch, rebuild, and start so the next read prompts again. In the app click Show on the Connection string row. When the macOS Keychain dialog opens, Stackly loses focus. Expect: after you click Allow the value does not show by itself and the row says `Hidden because Stackly went to the background. Press Show to try again.` in red, with Show and Copy enabled again and no masked text change. Click Show again: it shows without a dialog. Now repeat the rebuild once more and click Copy instead: expect the dialog, and after Allow the note `Copied. The clipboard clears in 90 seconds.` with the full URI on the pasteboard (`pbpaste`), because Copy is not cancelled by the app turning inactive. Cleanup: Delete Reference…, confirm, quit the app, stop the daemon, and check Keychain Access has no `stackly-secret` item left. If the dialog never makes the app inactive on this Mac, write that down instead.
Write down the macOS version and, for every step above that did not match, the step number and what you saw instead.
